synthetic_freeze.acceptance: Evidence manifest and existing release checks can be regenerated.

local_runtime_audit.acceptance: Missing, unlisted, changed, or unavailable channels fail closed.

noisy_dependent_observations.acceptance: Schema-complete pilot data is generated with noise, missingness, costs, and within-episode dependence.

external_replication.acceptance: Named unaffiliated reviewer returns dated code, logs, and discrepancy report.

crypto_calibration.acceptance: Held-out public crypto data validates spread, depth, fills, impact, and regime behavior.

matched_ai_non_ai.acceptance: Any AI-specific result survives matched adaptive non-AI and frozen-policy controls.

operational_validation.acceptance: Interventions reduce a declared out-of-sample loss target without loss shifting.

novelty_publication.acceptance: Independent predecessor, authorship, rights, ethics, and venue reviews are documented.
